note: رسمي, pre-show reminder replacing the deleted 27 Oct T0 Reel (card adv-20261027-indie-world-deleted): moving official footage only. Nintendo posted no video for the 28 Oct show (NoA and IndieWorldNA posts are stills), so the footage is the official Steam launch trailers of three games from earlier Indie World showcases (Denshattack!, Mar 2026; Mina the Hollower, Jul 2025; Ball x Pit, Aug 2025), 1080p, credited on screen as earlier Indie World games; nothing implies they are in this show. Times from Nintendo of America's post (7am PT = 14:00 UTC = 18:00 UAE, 17:00 KSA); length: about 15 minutes (NoA) and about 25 (Nintendo Japan's own show). Our bed (Ball x Pit is narrated; the others music only).
